assignments.explanation: Capacity 4 fits 4; required equipment available. Bayesian posterior from hypothetical unknown report: 0.800. Assumed travel 2.9 min; delay 0 min. Synthetic utility 119.65. Known local reservations are hard constraints; probability never overrides a booking.

decision_advice.explanation: Choose inspect: highest expected synthetic utility among allowed actions. Book uses 0.800*10+(1-0.800)*-8. Inspection purchases a noisy observation without changing occupancy. Waiting changes the belief using the occupancy transition. Both consume one action opportunity; booking and leaving terminate. At horizon 1 only book/leave are allowed.
decision_advice.model: Finite-horizon belief-state POMDP solved by backward Bellman recursion; not value iteration
